bugs.name: Repository pagination keeps highlighting page 1 after navigating to another page
bugs.summary: The repository list advances to page 2 and the URL becomes ?page=2&date=, but the sidebar paginator continues to highlight 1; this persists after settling and reproduces again from the dashboard root.
bugs.expected: After using the next-page control, the repository pagination should highlight the page currently shown, matching the page in the URL.
bugs.actual: At /?page=2&date=, the repository list changes but the paginator continues to highlight 1. After a 5-second wait it still shows 1; clicking next again produces page=3 with 1 still highlighted. Repeating from the root and navigating to page 2 reproduces the mismatch.
reproSteps: Use the authenticated momentic-admin account (provided authenticated session; no credentials entered) and open / at 1024×1366 CSS pixels. Confirm All is selected and repository search is empty.
Click the next-page chevron immediately to the right of 1 at the bottom of the repository sidebar.
Observe the repository list change and the URL become /?page=2&date=; the paginator still highlights 1. Wait 5 seconds and observe that the mismatch remains.
Return to the dashboard root and repeat the next-page action. The URL again becomes page=2 while the paginator continues highlighting 1.
bugs.reason: On the exact pinned image, the assigned repository next-page control correctly highlights page 2 and sets repo-search-page=2 on both attempts after five-second waits. The reported page-1 highlight and page/date URL do not occur in this flow.
